text.p: Tottenham chairman Alan Sugar said on Sunday his club had completed the six million pounds ($10 million) signing of Newcastle and England striker Les Ferdinand.
Ferdinand, 30, agreed personal terms with the London club on Sunday, ending speculation that Newcastle might try to stop the move in the wake of Alan Shearer's injury.
Shearer injured ankle ligaments in Saturday's friendly against Chelsea on Saturday and according to manager Kenny Dalglish will be out of action for "months rather than weeks".
Tottenham, who sold another England striker Teddy Sheringham to Manchester United earlier in the close season, will "unveil" Londoner Ferdinand at their training ground on Monday.
